description: Get information about the current user and drive storage quota.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the about object (user, storageQuota, maxUploadSize).

description: List files, optionally filtered by a Drive query string and ordered/paginated.

q.description: Optional Drive query string (e.g. "trashed = false", "'folder-eng' in parents", "name contains 'rfc'").

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return per page (default 100).

page_token.description: Optional pagination offset token from a previous call.

order_by.description: Ordering directive, e.g. 'modifiedTime desc', 'createdTime asc', 'name asc'.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a fileList (kind, files, nextPageToken).

description: Get a single file's metadata by its id.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the file object; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Download the text content of a file by its id (text-based mime types only).

file_id.description: The unique id of the file to download.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has file_id, name, mime_type, size_bytes, content; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new file or folder, optionally under a parent folder.

name.description: The name of the new file.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the new file.

parent_id.description: Optional id of the parent folder.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created file object; on failure (parent not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update a file's name, parent, starred, or trashed state.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated file object; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Move a file to the trash by its id.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file to trash.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated (trashed) file object; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Permanently delete a file and its permissions by its id.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has deleted and id; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the permissions granted on a file.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a permissionList (kind, permissions); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Grant a new permission on a file to a user, group, domain, or anyone.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file.

email_address.description: Optional email address of the grantee.

display_name.description: Optional display name of the grantee.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created permission object; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Revoke a permission from a file by permission id.

file_id.description: The unique id of the file.

permission_id.description: The unique id of the permission to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has deleted and id; on failure (permission not found), output contains an error message.
